label: Chapter 02

sentences.en: Trust only movement.
sentences.zh: 只相信行动。

sentences.en: Life happens at the level of events, not of words.
sentences.zh: 生活发生在事件的层面，而不是言语的层面。

sentences.en: Trust movement.
sentences.zh: 相信行动。

sentences.en: – Alfred Adler
sentences.zh: —— 阿尔弗雷德·阿德勒

sentences.en: If you want to change who you are, you must understand how the mind works so that you can start to reprogram it in the direction of the person who you want to be.
sentences.zh: 如果你想改变自己，就必须先理解心智是如何运作的，这样你才能开始把它重新编程，朝着你想成为的那个人前进。

sentences.en: The first step to understanding the mind is to understand that all behavior is goal-oriented.
sentences.zh: 理解心智的第一步，是明白所有行为都是有目标导向的。

sentences.en: It's the same in biology as it is in human life.
sentences.zh: 生物学如此，人生亦然。

sentences.en: To survive, you must act toward a goal.
sentences.zh: 要生存，你必须朝着某个目标行动。

sentences.en: If you don't act toward a goal, you don't survive.
sentences.zh: 如果你不朝着目标行动，你就无法生存。

sentences.en: You take a step forward because you want to reach a certain location.
sentences.zh: 你向前迈出一步，是因为你想到达某个地方。

sentences.en: You scratch your nose because you want to make the itch go away.
sentences.zh: 你挠鼻子，是因为你想让痒感消失。

sentences.en: Those ones are clear, but most of the time, your goals are unconscious.
sentences.zh: 这些例子很清楚，但大多数时候，你的目标是无意识的。

sentences.en: You may not realize that when you sit on the couch in the middle of the day, you are trying to burn time before your next responsibility, as one simple example.
sentences.zh: 你可能没有意识到，当你在白天中途坐在沙发上时，你其实是在打发时间，等下一个责任到来——这只是一个简单的例子。

sentences.en: On an even more unconscious and complex level, you pursue goals that can harm you, but you justify your behavior by saying something else.
sentences.zh: 在更无意识、更复杂的层面上，你会追求那些可能伤害你的目标，却用别的说法来为自己的行为辩解。

sentences.en: For example, if you procrastinate your work and tell yourself you need a break, you are not pursuing the goal of rest.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你拖延工作，还告诉自己需要休息一下，那你追求的并不是休息这个目标。

sentences.en: You are pursuing a goal of escaping discomfort.
sentences.zh: 你追求的是逃避不适这个目标。

sentences.en: And that goal of escaping discomfort is a "dysfunctional" goal that is inconsistent with your primary goal.
sentences.zh: 而逃避不适这个目标是一个“功能失调的”目标，与你的主要目标不一致。

sentences.en: As an example, if you can't stop procrastinating your work, you may justify it with the fact that you lack motivation, or you may say you are resting.
sentences.zh: 再举个例子，如果你无法停止拖延工作，你可能会以缺乏动力为借口，或者说自己是在休息。

sentences.en: That "self-compassion" you give yourself may be a justification used to avoid a difficult task, and that avoidance is a harmful goal that pulls you away from true growth.
sentences.zh: 你给自己的那种“自我关怀”，可能是用来逃避困难任务的借口，而这种逃避是一个有害的目标，会把你拉离真正的成长。

sentences.en: If you say you want to quit your dead-end job, but stay in it without any real reason, you may start to create justifications such as "I need the money" (you and I both know that's not true) even when you know that it's not true, which leads to mental gymnastics and self-deception.
sentences.zh: 如果你说想辞掉那份没有前途的工作，却没有任何真正的理由一直待在那里，你可能会开始编造一些借口，比如“我需要这份钱”（你我都知道这不是真的），即使你明知这不是真的，这会导致你陷入自我合理化的心理游戏和自我欺骗。

sentences.en: The lesson here is that real change requires changing your goals.
sentences.zh: 这里的教训是，真正的改变需要改变你的目标。

sentences.en: I don't mean setting some surface-level goal because the act of doing that serves an unconscious goal that is harmful to you.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是设定某个表面目标，因为那样做本身就是在服务于一个对你有害的无意识目标。

sentences.en: The lesson is that your current goals, which you don't even realize you're pursuing, must shift.
sentences.zh: 教训是，你目前那些甚至没有意识到自己在追求的目标，必须转变。

sentences.en: That's why what we call "self-awareness" is so important.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们所说的“自我觉察”如此重要。

sentences.en: Now let's dig a bit deeper, because if you don't understand this, it only becomes more difficult to change, and you won't do the exercises.
sentences.zh: 现在让我们再深入一点，因为如果你不理解这一点，改变只会变得更加困难，而且你也不会去做那些练习。

sentences.en: Before we dig in, I want to briefly share the work that I am doing.
sentences.zh: 在深入之前，我想简要分享一下我正在做的工作。

sentences.en: I know that most of you are teachers, writers, coders, or creators in some shape or form, and this newsletter is the best way of knowing about you that I have found.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们中的大多数人是教师、作家、程序员，或者某种形式的创作者，而这份通讯是我了解你们的最好方式。

sentences.en: I send out letters like these 1-2x a week.
sentences.zh: 我每周会发出一到两次这样的信件。

sentences.en: If you don't want to miss them, join here.
sentences.zh: 如果你不想错过它们，就在这里加入。

sentences.en: You can also read my book free, other letters, etc.
sentences.zh: 你也可以免费读我的书、其他信件等等。

sentences.en: The foundation of this newsletter is the premise that: Becoming a creator is the best chance you have at taking control of your own knowledge, skills, and ultimately, your life.
sentences.zh: 这份通讯的基础是这样一个前提：成为一名创作者，是你掌控自己的知识、技能，并最终掌控自己人生的最大机会。

sentences.en: It's about creator independence.
sentences.zh: 这关乎创作者的独立。

sentences.en: The ability to tell your own story.
sentences.zh: 关乎讲述自己故事的能力。

sentences.en: And ultimately, to control your own destiny.
sentences.zh: 并最终掌控自己的命运。

sentences.en: That's a goal I genuinely believe in, and I will continue to write about it for the rest of my life.
sentences.zh: 这是我真心相信的目标，我会在余生继续书写它。

sentences.en: Being 5% more free in the future will not be an insignificant change, it will mean that your perception of reality will have shifted enough to create the life you want to live.
sentences.zh: 未来自由 5%，绝不是一个微不足道的变化，它意味着你对现实的感知已经转变到足以创造你想过的生活。

sentences.en: With that in mind: you need not have a goal greater than becoming a creator.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这一点：你不需要有比成为一名创作者更宏大的目标。

title_en: II – You aren't where you want to be because you don't want to be there
title_zh: 二、你不在你想去的地方，是因为你并不真的想去那里

vocab.example_en: She is a goal-oriented manager who sets clear targets for her team.
I tend to procrastinate when a task feels boring or difficult.

vocab.def_zh: 功能失调的；不能正常运作的
vocab.example_en: Their dysfunctional communication style made every meeting longer than necessary.
Practising self-compassion helped her recover from failure without harsh self-blame.
Telling himself he had plenty of time was pure self-deception.
